command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'display_scale_host_probe.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, time
from ctypes import wintypes as w
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil

shcore=c.windll.shcore
try:
    shcore.GetScaleFactorForDevice.argtypes=[c.c_int]
    shcore.GetScaleFactorForDevice.restype=c.c_int
    print("SCALE_FACTOR_PRIMARY",shcore.GetScaleFactorForDevice(0),flush=True)
except Exception as e:
    print("SCALE_FACTOR_ERROR",repr(e),flush=True)

shell32=c.windll.shell32
shell32.ShellExecuteW.argtypes=[w.HWND,c.c_wchar_p,c.c_wchar_p,c.c_wchar_p,c.c_wchar_p,c.c_int]
shell32.ShellExecuteW.restype=w.HINSTANCE
r=shell32.ShellExecuteW(None,"open","ms-settings:display",None,None,1)
print("SHELLEXECUTE_RESULT",int(c.cast(r,c.c_void_p).value or 0),flush=True)
time.sleep(6)
rows=[]
for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows():
    try:
        pid=x.element_info.process_id
        pname=psutil.Process(pid).name()
        title=x.window_text()
        rows.append((pname,pid,title,x.element_info.control_type))
    except Exception:
        pass
print("TOPLEVEL_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
for row in rows:
    print("TOPLEVEL",repr(row),flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
